record.one_liner: Email and marketing automation platform for managing audiences, campaigns, automations and reporting.
record.auth_notes: API key sent as HTTP Basic auth password (any string as username). OAuth2 authorization-code flow for third-party apps (login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/authorize and /token); apps registered via a self-service Registered Apps form. API keys give full account access; keys created on/after 2026-06-22 expire after one year.
record.access_notes: Any user with Manager role or higher can generate an API key in the account profile; OAuth app registration needs only a Mailchimp account. The fetched pages do not state which plan tiers include API access, so whether a Free plan works is not verified here. The fetched OAuth page does not mention an approval step (inferred self-serve). Rate limits were not verified.
record.blocker: Plan-tier requirement for API access and rate limits not confirmed from vendor pages. API keys are full-account scope and now expire yearly, so OAuth2 is preferable for multi-user toolkit. A hosted endpoint (ai-inc.mailchimp.com/claude/mcp/v2) appeared in a third-party listing but I could not confirm it on Mailchimp's own docs, so it is not counted as official.

evidence.auth: https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/guides/access-user-data-oauth-2/ (OAuth2 flow, self-service app registration); https://mailchimp.com/help/about-api-keys/ (API key creation, Manager role, expiry); https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/guides/quick-start/ (Basic auth with API key)
evidence.access: https://mailchimp.com/help/about-api-keys/ (Manager+ can create keys; no plan requirement stated)
evidence.mcp: No vendor page found. Third-party only: https://pypi.org/project/mailchimp-mcp/ (appeared in search results, not fetched)
